verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (product, then headline, subline and CTA) in a clean left-aligned text column, with a good size step from headline to subline to button. Its only flaws are minor: the large product circle crowds the left and top edges, and the headline runs close to the right margin. B breaks the reading order: the headline floats alone on the left, the oversized 'Try It' pill butts against the bottom of the product circle, and 'Out now.' is stuck after the button as an afterthought. That leaves a cramped cluster on the right next to dead space under the headline.
